subject.title: [Feature]: Support Slack Agent View without breaking Assistant View installs

question: Should OpenClaw make Agent View the generated Slack experience for new workspace apps while retaining Assistant View as a supported compatibility lifecycle for existing installations?
rationale: Slack now requires Agent View for new apps, but this choice changes an irreversible setup default and commits the bundled plugin to two external lifecycle contracts across session, delivery, and recovery paths.

options.title: Sponsor dual lifecycle
options.body: Approve Agent View for new generated manifests and retain Assistant View runtime support with the issue’s complete fresh-install, restart, routing, and legacy acceptance matrix.

options.title: Pause generated support
options.body: Keep the current generator unchanged and document that new Agent View apps are pending until the dual lifecycle can be implemented and proven as one coherent change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor dual lifecycle
recommendation.body: Approve Agent View for new generated manifests and retain Assistant View runtime support with the issue’s complete fresh-install, restart, routing, and legacy acceptance matrix.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current Assistant lifecycle and is the live assignee for the new product direction and acceptance environment.
